correctness.rationale: A proper nonempty cycle subset is a path forest; marking a one-run start gives n choices of position and exactly r marks per labelled subset, including symmetric run configurations. For deficiency d the number r of components is at most d. For fixed shape there are O_d(n) labelled subsets and at most 2^d d! isomorphisms between any two. Thus the O_d(n^(r−1)) shapes with r<d give O_d(n^d) total. When r=d all d gaps are unit; imposing a unit part or equality of two parts in a d-part composition costs one degree of freedom, so all such exceptions cost O_d(n^d) maps as well. The good shapes number n^(d−1)/(d!(d−1)!)+O_d(n^(d−2)); for each there are n(d−1)! choices for each of domain and image and 2^d orientation choices. This proves the leading coefficient 2^d/d; d=1 separately gives exactly 2n² even at n=3. The original context checks also hold: empty and full contributions are 1 and 2n, the component bound and independent-set factorial sandwich give the claimed growth and rank deviation exponent, and the two-point distance witness works precisely for n≥6. For the path comparison, each rank-k map with k<n admits at least one pair of omitted vertices and each of the n² possible pairs is isomorphic to the reference P_(n−1) problem. Neither counting convention quotients labelled domains or maps.

value.rationale: The natural fixed-deficiency stratum detects near-complete partial symmetries, a regime not characterized by typical-rank behavior. The uniform formula in each fixed positive deficiency gives both the growth power and a nontrivial leading coefficient, and identifies which domain/image structures account for that order and which are lower by a full power of n. This is reusable quantitative information rather than the evaluation of an arbitrary small case.
